title: Two-branch subset sum
prompt: Implement `boolean subset(int[] arr, int i, int target)`: can some subset of arr[i..] sum to target? Two branches at each element (take it / skip it); base cases: target == 0 → true, i exhausted → target == 0. Trace {2, 5, 3}, target 8 by hand.

tests.name: subset exists
tests.hint: if (target == 0) return true; if (i >= arr.length) return false; return subset(arr, i+1, target - arr[i]) || subset(arr, i+1, target);
